command: out=$(bash scripts/verify-lim.sh 2>/dev/null); rc=$?; n=$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE "^[0-9]{2} [a-z0-9-]+ (PASS|FAIL)"); f=$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE "^[0-9]{2} [a-z0-9-]+ FAIL"); test "$n" -eq 16 && test "$rc" -eq "$f"
c=$(bash scripts/verify-lim.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(03|07) " | grep -c FAIL); test "$c" -eq 2
